Rust/Wasm skeleton palettes

Tests the compiled skeleton and hierarchy kernels against pinned Three.js r186. Requires the existing Wasm build at /pkg/f3d_runtime.js and the pinned upstream build under /upstream/three.js. No GPU is required.

This checks numeric bone palettes, shared joints, texture-backed palette storage, precision boundaries and the hierarchy-to-skeleton connection. It does not certify GPU skinning, a rendered image, animation scheduling, or a measured speedup.
